summary: Financial support up to DKK 50,000 for students in higher or upper secondary education to develop an idea or start their own business. The grant is paid as invoiced services or products approved within the scope of the grant. Applicants with a CVR number must provide 25% self-financing. Multiple invoices (up to 4) can be submitted. Purchases outside Europe require upfront payment and documentation for reimbursement.
eligible_applicants: Startups with a CVR number (business registration number)
activity_types: Purchasing services or products related to the grant
reporting_requirements: Answer questionnaires from The Danish Foundation for Entrepreneurship
Invoice approval and submission for payment
Adherence to budget and grant terms
